name: أطفئ الأضواء
tagline: كل ضغطة تقلب ضوءًا وجيرانه. أطفئها كلها.
description: العب أطفئ الأضواء مجانًا: كل ضغطة تقلب ضوءًا وجيرانه. أطفئ الشبكة كلها وحدك أو في سباق مع أصدقائك عبر الإنترنت.
about: Lights Off is a small grid of lights with one simple rule: pressing a light switches it, and also switches the lights directly above, below, left and right of it. Some lights start on. Your job is to turn every one of them off.

It sounds easy until you try. Every press changes up to five lights, so fixing one corner tends to undo another. There's a pattern to it, though: the order of presses doesn't matter, and pressing the same light twice does nothing at all, so every solution is really just a set of lights to press once.

Each puzzle is made by pressing random lights on a dark board, so there is always a way back. When you finish, the game tells you the fewest presses that would have done it. Play 4 × 4 up to 7 × 7, alone or racing friends online.
howToPlay: Choose a size to start. The clock starts with the puzzle.
Tap a light to press it. It switches on or off, and so do its neighbours above, below, left and right.
Lights on the edge have fewer neighbours, and corner lights fewer still.
Turn every light off to finish.
Your time and presses are shown at the end, along with the fewest presses possible.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a light.
Keyboard: move with the arrow keys and press Enter or Space to press a light.
Pause or start a new puzzle from the bar above the game.
tips: Work row by row: for each light still on, press the one directly below it. At the end, only the bottom row is left.
The bottom row's pattern tells you which lights in the top row to press first; then sweep down again.
Pressing a light twice undoes it, so never press the same light twice in a row.
The order doesn't matter: you can press the lights of a solution in any order.
On larger grids, the row-by-row method is reliable even when you can't see the shortcut.

faq.question: Is Lights Off free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Can every puzzle be solved?
faq.answer: Yes. Each puzzle is made by pressing random lights on a dark board, so pressing the same lights again would always clear it.

faq.question: What is the 'fewest presses' at the end?
faq.answer: The smallest number of presses that solves that starting position, worked out by the game. Matching it is a good challenge.

faq.question: How do races work?
faq.answer: Everyone in the room gets the same lights at the same moment, and the first to turn them all off wins.
